content: कल्प {%a.%} [कॢप्-घञ्] .²1 Practicable, feasible, possible, .²2 Proper, fit, right. .²3 Strong, vigorous; चरन्तं ब्राह्मणं कञ्चित्कल्पचित्तमनामयम् <ls>Mb. 12. 179. 3</ls>. .²4 Able, competent (with a <ab>gen.</ab>, <ab>loc.</ab>; <ab>inf.</ab> or at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); धर्मस्य, यशसः, कल्पः <ls>Bhāg.</ls> able to do his duty <ab>&c.</ab>; स्वक्रियायामकल्पः {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%} not competent to do oneʼs duty; अकल्प एषामधिरोढुमञ्जसा पदम् {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%}, so स्वभरणाकल्प <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-ल्पः@} .²1 A sacred precept or rule, law, ordinance. .²2 A prescribed rule, a prescribed alternative, optional rule; प्रभुः प्रथमकल्पस्य योऽनुकल्पेन वर्तते <ls>Ms. 11. 30</ls> ‘able to follow the prescribed rule to be observed in preference to all others’; प्रथमः कल्पः <ls>M. 1</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>Pratimā 4</ls>, and <ls>Abhiṣeka. 6</ls> and <ls>Ś. 4</ls>. a very good (or best) alternative; एष वै प्रथमः कल्पः प्रदाने हव्यकव्ययोः <ls>Ms. 3. 147</ls>. .²3 (Hence) A proposal, suggestion, resolve, determination; एष मे प्रथमः कल्पः <ls>Rām. 2. 52. 63</ls>; उदारः कल्पः <ls>Ś. 7</ls>. .²4 Manner of acting, procedure, form, way, method (in religious rites); श्रूयते हि पुराकल्पे <ls>Mb. 6. 43. 23</ls>; क्षात्रेण कल्पेनोपनीय <ls>U. 2</ls>; कल्पवित्कल्पयामास वन्यामेवास्य संविधाम् <ls>R. 1. 94</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 185</ls>. .²5 End of the world, universal destruction. .²6 A day of Brahmā or 1,000 Yugas, being a period of 432 million years of mortals and measuring the duration of the world; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Bhāg. 3. 11</ls>; श्रीश्वेतवाराहकल्पे [the one in which we now live]; कल्पं स्थितं तनुभृतां तनुभिस्ततः किम् <ls>Śānti. 4. 2</ls>. Hence काल्पिक means ‘born in the primeval age’ <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 48</ls>. .²7 Medical treatment of the sick. .²8 One of the six Vedāṅgas, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} that which lays down the ritual and prescribes rules for ceremonial and sacrificial acts; शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणम् <ls>Muṇḍ. 1. 1. 5</ls> see under वेदाङ्ग. .²9 A termination added to nouns and adjectives in the sense of ‘a little less than’, ‘almost like’, ‘nearly equal to’, <ls>P. V. 3. 67</ls> [denoting similarity with a degree of inferiority]; कुमारकल्पं सुषुवे कुमारम् <ls>R. 5. 36</ls>; उपपन्नमेतदस्मिन्नृषिकल्पे राजनि <ls>Ś. 2</ls>; प्रभातकल्पा शशिनेव शर्वरी <ls>R. 3. 2</ls>; so मृतकल्पः, प्रतिपन्नकल्पः <ab>&c.</ab> .²10 The doctrine of poisons and antidotes. .²11 One of the trees of paradise; <ab>cf.</ab> कल्पद्रुम. .²12 Vigour, strength; लौकिके समयाचारे कृतकल्पो विशारदः <ls>Rām. 2. 1. 22</ls>. .{@-ल्पा, -ल्पम्@} A kind of intoxicating liquor.
